title: Overlays: which picture for which words, when it lands, how many

entries.when: a number, price, count or percentage is spoken
entries.do: Counter that rolls from 0 (or the old value) to the number in 0.6-0.9 s, landing on the spoken word; unit and label in small text; tick sound per 10 steps; hold 1.2 s after landing.

evidence.note: 1,74,736 stars counting up; 64 AGENTS / 261 SKILLS boxes
1 -> 23 fixes found
581,314 head counter

entries.do: Dial or gauge whose needle moves from the old to the new value on the keyword with a slight overshoot; label 'SLOW' to '10x'; colour shifts cold to hot.

evidence.note: speed dial 0 to 10x with 'SLOW' to '10x' chips

entries.do: Price tag with the old price struck through, then a FREE stamp slaps in rotated 6-10 degrees with an impact sound; the stamp stays 1.2 s.

evidence.note: ₹4,999 course card with FREE stamp
'completely free'

entries.when: the call to action: comment KEYWORD
entries.do: A comment box types the keyword letter by letter over 0.6 s, the send button presses, a DM 'access' bubble returns; the keyword is also in the caption; last 4-6 s of the video.

evidence.note: comment box 'PRESELL' with Post button
REELS typed in a comment field, access reply
comments phone with HIGGS

entries.do: Dark terminal window, the command types at 25-35 characters per second with a cursor; the keyword in the command is highlighted; result line appears 0.4 s after the Enter key.

evidence.note: terminal with '/arena Write a cold email'
npx ecc-universal command
terminal + step chips

entries.when: step one, step two, first, second, process, workflow
entries.do: White window card with a step chip 'STEP 2/5', one title, 1-3 lines of content and a progress bar; enters with scale 92 to 100 % in 220 ms; replaced, not stacked.

evidence.note: STEP 1/4 Connect Playwright, Search 200 career pages, Match to resume, Fill every form
STEP 3/6 chips with a running clock

entries.when: connects, team, system, all of, ecosystem, N tools
entries.do: Centre node (the product) and 4-8 spokes that draw one by one in step with the spoken items; each spoke label lands on its word.

evidence.note: Claude centre with Planner, Architect, Coder, Reviewer, Tester, Security
hex hub of skills

entries.when: devices, accounts, files, found, unknown, blocked, secured
entries.do: A list card whose rows get tags (Yours / Not recognized / Blocked) one row per spoken item; red tags pulse once; the last state turns green.

evidence.note: Devices on your Wi-Fi: Unknown device 'Not recognized' -> 'Blocked'

entries.when: stars, followers, views, users, repo, open source, github
entries.do: A profile or repo card with the real-looking figure; stars fall into a jar for 'stars'; figure counts up; the card shows licence and name.

evidence.note: stars falling into a jar to 11,160
GitHub profile with 294k stars
repo cards with star counts

entries.when: a big number the viewer cannot picture (a million views, 107,601 seats)
entries.do: Convert to a familiar unit ('nearly 10 Michigan football stadiums') with 10 small icons filling one by one; the formula shown in small mono under it.

evidence.note: 1,000,000 views as stadium icons with capacity formula

entries.when: a countdown, a score, players alive, days left across a series
entries.do: Top-left HUD: red dot + label, big white number, small caption; the number changes with a flick when the story changes it; the same HUD (position, font) in every part of the series; end card 'PART N, follow for part N+1'.

evidence.note: 90 DAYS LEFT / 100 PLAYERS ALIVE

entries.when: a place, rule, price or title belongs to the world
entries.do: Put the text on a prop inside the scene (neon sign, banner, road sign, shop sign, desk monitor) so it follows the camera in perspective; keep it under 5 words; light it with the scene.

evidence.note: DON'T HIT THIS TREE neon, YOUR SPEED 15 sign
COW'S HAY SHOP, ONE RAW = 1 COIN
OPENING TOMORROW banner

entries.when: a stat belongs to a character (steps left, coins, health)
entries.do: A rounded dark badge above the head with the number in white/green; follows the head; changes colour on a threshold.

evidence.note: badges 581,314, 703,519, 300 above heads

entries.when: emphasise, point at, 'this one', mistakes, circle it
entries.do: A hand-drawn circle, underline or arrow draws on in 350-500 ms (stroke-dashoffset), wobbles 1 px, in the style accent; one per 5 s.

evidence.note: red hand-drawn circle on a UI element
red pen strike-through on a transcript line

entries.do: No template twice within 6 s; at most 4 overlays visible; every overlay lasts 0.9 s + 0.28 s per word; an overlay never covers the face box or the caption zone; the first overlay lands inside 3 s.

evidence.note: a different animated scene for every phrase, nothing repeated
